summary: Theme Forge fixes verified - Fixed critical bug where built-in themes weren't applying CSS variables. Light/Dark mode toggle, built-in themes, and preview mode all working correctly.

bugs_fixed_by_tester.issue: Built-in themes not applying CSS variables
bugs_fixed_by_tester.root_cause: API response structure mismatch - API returns {status, theme: {...}} but code expected colors at res.data.colors instead of res.data.theme.colors
bugs_fixed_by_tester.fix: Updated applyBuiltInTheme and applyCustomColors to access res.data.theme instead of res.data directly

light_dark_mode_toggle.details: Toggle between light/dark modes works correctly. CSS variables update, body class changes (dark-mode/light-mode), data-theme attribute updates

theme_persistence.details: Theme mode saved to localStorage under 'watchnexus_theme_mode' key

built_in_themes.details: All 6 built-in themes (Living Room, Cinema, Anime Pop, Audio Waves, Minimal, Streaming Service) now apply their colors correctly

active_badge.details: 'Active' badge correctly shows on selected theme and moves when theme is changed

custom_theme_preview.details: Preview button toggles to 'Stop Preview', color changes applied in real-time

switch_component_visibility.details: Switch component updated to use secondary color (#EC4899) for better visibility in both dark and light modes

appearance_mode_section.details: Dark Mode and Light Mode options visible with sun/moon icons, toggle switch working

context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme Forge is fully functional. Built-in themes apply colors, light/dark mode works, preview mode works. The fix was in ThemeContext.js where API response was being accessed incorrectly.
